meta.parties: Dingiri Banda Et Al. v. Podi Bandara

rules.statement: An order admitting a claim under section 4(1) of the Waste Lands Ordinance does not confer absolute title on the claimant unless it is made in pursuance of an agreement with the Settlement Officer.
rules.supporting_quote: "For this reason I am of opinion that the order 6 D 5 does not confer absolute title on the respondent."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 4 (1) of the Waste Lands Ordinance
